confidence_notes: Food estimates use a [June 2026 Numbeo snapshot](https://www.expatica.com/jp/cost-of-living/tokyo/) and [current Tokyo prices](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Tokyo). Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain and use their relationship to beer alongside [local bar ranges](https://bar-find.com/main/blog?seq=64). Accommodation is a general-knowledge estimate for July; prices vary with dates and location.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tokyo restaurant data provides the primary basis, with Osaka as a broad comparison for a major Japanese visitor destination.
